primaryChecks.text: The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh. Their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
contextRefs: JOS 19:21 — Remeth, Engannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez.
